role: post-v2 explanatory decomposition; not independent confirmation
trigger: v2 did not support residual individual-by-location interaction after marginal altitude preference was controlled

model.species_marginal: Equal-individual mean of Jeffreys-smoothed early P_i(z).
model.individual_marginal: P_i(z) = (raw early individual z counts + lambda * P_species(z)) / (n_i + lambda).

primary_test.pairwise_gain: For source individual i and target late individual j, mean log P_i(z) - log P_species(z).
primary_test.observed: mean identity-matched diagonal gain across eight individuals
primary_test.null: all 8! permutations of source identity assigned to late target identity
primary_test.one_sided_p: fraction of all permutations with assigned mean gain >= observed diagonal mean
primary_test.support_rule: P <= 0.05 and at least 6 of 8 diagonal gains > 0
primary_test.interpretation_if_pass: stable individual-specific marginal altitude distributions explain a substantial component of the v1 identity-transfer signal
primary_test.interpretation_if_fail: marginal altitude preference alone does not explain the v1 identity-transfer signal

prohibited: post-hoc change to lambda or z bins after v3 output
